name: Gauge
description: Gauge tubes filling further with every row down the canvas — a whole scale read at a glance.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 26%; top: 6%; width: 48%; height: 88%; box-sizing: border-box; border: calc(10px / @Y) solid @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 32%; top: @calc(88 - 78 * @y / @Y)%; width: 36%; height: @calc(78 * @y / @Y)%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
